usable_rule: source == ia_russian; candidate_usable is true (fixed_usable, no text_exclusions, deduplicated by collector); crop and crop_sha256 and complete regeneration recipe present; id absent from union of release_exclusions.json classes[*].file. Crop existence is regenerability, not presence of the disposable original crop. Do not apply stratum_gate: ia_russian is withheld pending this correction. All selected rows also have usable_final=true.
prior_method: Casefold Cyrillic token stem before the yer, without spelling normalization. Leave the target occurrence out of W1 label stem counts, including pre_hyphen. If other occurrences show both signs => both; only one => that sign_only. Otherwise unknown. No dictionary guesses or ink truth. Corpus evidence may itself contain Google errors; this is only a cross-check, never an edit decision.

pack_closure.verification: All packed PNG bytes equal their verified source SHA256; unique source IDs within each context; complete bed covered once; nine slot-bearing controls per context; manifests verified.

receipt_hash_policy: Receipt excludes itself; all pack files and manifests and local deliverables hashed; original RU10 receipt retained.
